text: Peace Park Capital invests in collateralized loan obligation (CLO) securities. Its team page lists Ron Baron, a founder, executive director and CIO of Livermore Investments Group.
short: Peace Park Capital is a CLO investor; its team includes Livermore's Ron Baron.

source.name: Peace Park Capital, 'About us'
source.quote: Peace Park generates attractive risk-adjusted returns through diversified exposure to and active management of collateralized loan obligation (CLO) securities
